_comment: Example policy for GRAPH_ENABLED=false + AD_LDAP_ENABLED=true deployments, where on-prem AD is the sole source of truth and device_found/user_found/compliance_state are never populated (Graph is never called). Copy this to POLICY_RULES_FILE (default /config/policy.json) and edit. Certs still need an entra-device-id, user-upn, or onprem-sid URN present (see README's 'Certificate identity convention') - only the onprem-sid is actually resolved in this mode.

rules.name: ad-device-missing-sid
rules.reason: certificate missing required onprem-sid URN for AD-only mode
